decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the 25 products, many were not actually backpacks (tents, blankets, chairs). I focused my consideration set on actual backpack-style items including general-purpose hiking packs, waterproof dry-bag backpacks, and specialized tactical/cooler packs. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is the standout choice; with over 14,000 reviews and a high rating at a very affordable price point, it represents the best value for a general-purpose daypack. The IDRYBAG (prod_backpacks_174) was a close second for water-specific needs, but the ZOMAKE's massive popularity and packability make it the most attractive purchase in this set.
